chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature), so that the calf does not reach over the seat.

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (|x| 0.018 to 0.066, y 0.672 to 0.73, z 0.052 to 0.098 in the source). The nose box holds the pink nose tip.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source, and a seat 1 cm deeper, so that the back keeps off the chair back.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H (0.2018 units of the source form) is 0.2985 m, the H of the rabbit of main. The hand rig keeps the form of the source, so only the scale of the whole body sets H. The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale.
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, mapped by the paw turns and the point edits of the hand rig (assets/models/rabbit/README.md): the edit of the paw size moves the knuckle joint and the tip of each fingers bone. The source places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (closed rings of 10 vertices): the shoulder joint at x 0.07, the elbow at x 0.1475, the wrist at x 0.225, the knuckles at x 0.268, and the tip at x 0.31. Leg (closed rings of 12 vertices): the hip joint at (0.0595, 0.287, 0.004) in the haunch, the knee at y 0.178, the ankle at y 0.055, the ball of the foot at z 0.055, and the toe tips at z 0.095. Trunk: the hips at y 0.31, the neck at y 0.585, and the head from y 0.615 to 0.80. Ears: the root at y 0.785, the tips at (0.10, 1.0, -0.065). Tail: a short bone from (0, 0.33, -0.08) back. The hip joint lies 0.5 mm forward of the measured place (z 0.0035), because with z 0.0035 the rest frames of the leg bones in Blender scale by 3e-5 (the thigh points nearly opposite to its parent), above the limit of pnpm rig-export.
